help: Add at least one curve row with a value for each axis.
rationale: The chart parses and renders an empty grid, so the missing curves are easy to miss.

summary: radar curve value count does not match the axis count
help: Give the curve one value per declared axis.
rationale: A positional curve with the wrong length renders a polygon whose points sit on the wrong axes.

summary: two radar axes carry the same label
help: Give each axis a distinct label.
rationale: Two axes with one label make the chart ambiguous, because a plotted value cannot be told which axis it belongs to.
